task: Semantic Execution Intelligence: project explicit planned file additions and canonical domain ownership changes before implementation without treating plan intent as actual architecture evidence.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: PR #666 plan-only replay after #678 now correctly authorizes the planned deletion, but still cannot prove storefront scope for live/new files whose canonical ownership is itself part of the planned domain-foundations edit. The Plan Gate evaluates current registry state only, so planned architecture changes are invisible before code. Planned authorization must be represented separately from actual registry evidence, exactly as planned deletion authorization is distinct from Git D completion proof.
observableOutcomes: Plan Before Code includes explicit planned additions in projectedFiles even when they do not yet exist in the repository.

An exact planned canonical ownership declaration can resolve projected domain/authority only when the canonical domain registry is itself inside the planned transaction and the referenced domain/owner already exists.
Projected ownership is exposed separately from current path-derived ownership and never mutates or masquerades as the actual Atlas.
Actual-diff validation ignores projected ownership and requires the implemented domain registry/current Atlas to resolve the file.
unresolvedRisks: Using expectedDomains as implicit ownership would make plan metadata a broad architecture bypass.
Allowing globs or unknown domains in projected ownership could authorize uncontrolled future files.
Applying projected ownership to actual-diff validation could hide a missing domain-foundations implementation.

in: Existing Semantic Execution Route planned-file projection.
Existing Plan Before Code projectedFiles and architecture scope evaluation.
Exact planned canonical ownership declarations tied to the existing domain-foundations authority.
Adversarial regression proving projection-only authority cannot satisfy actual completion.
out: New gate, new architecture registry, or automatic domain ownership inference from expectedDomains.
Weakening actual Atlas validation, Edit-Time Guard, Truth Gate, or canonical domain registry requirements.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This is a pre-execution architecture-proof gap. The highest practical correction is a phase-aware projected architecture overlay constrained by exact file paths, an already-existing domain/owner, and an explicitly planned canonical registry edit, while actual-diff remains grounded only in implemented Atlas evidence.

acceptanceCriteria: A concrete planned addition listed in semanticExecutionRoute.plannedAdditions participates in projectedFiles before it exists.

A concrete planned ownership mapping resolves projected scope only if its domain exists, owner matches the domain authority, target file is inside the plan envelope, and quality/knowledge/domain-foundations.v1.json is planned for modification.
Current pathDerived ownership remains unchanged and projected ownership is reported separately.
Actual-diff scope uses actual Atlas ownership only and does not consume the projection overlay.
Unknown domains, wrong owners, wildcard paths, out-of-plan targets, and ownership declarations without a planned domain registry edit remain blocked.
invariants: Projected architecture is authorization, never implemented architecture evidence.
Actual Atlas remains the canonical completion authority.
Projected ownership paths are exact concrete repository paths, never globs.
Domain and owner must already be canonical identities in the domain registry.
The canonical domain registry file must be part of the planned transaction before projection authority exists.

failureModes: A valid architecture-changing task deadlocks because planned ownership cannot be represented before editing the registry.
A self-asserted domain in expectedDomains silently authorizes arbitrary paths.
A planned new file is absent from projectedFiles and escapes pre-execution architecture review.
Actual implementation omits the registry update but passes by reusing projected intent.
edgeCases: Existing live file gains canonical ownership in the same transaction.
New file plus planned ownership before file creation.
Exact path declaration with unknown domain.
Exact path declaration with wrong owner.
Actual diff after code but registry update omitted.

alternatives.summary: Add exact projected additions/ownership to the existing Semantic Execution plan model.
alternatives.reason: Preserves plan-before-code ordering while separating authorization from implementation evidence.

alternatives.summary: Pre-merge the product-specific domain registry changes only to make the plan pass.
alternatives.reason: Would move product architecture implementation ahead of its own validated plan and hide the capability gap.

alternatives.summary: Assign unresolved planned files from expectedDomains.
alternatives.reason: Ambiguous and unsafe; expected scope is not file ownership authority.

specialistReviews.finding: Projected authority and actual authority must remain distinct objects.
specialistReviews.resolution: Return projected ownership separately and use it only in planned-projection calculations.

specialistReviews.finding: Self-declared ownership can become a bypass.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require exact path, existing canonical domain+owner, target inside plan, and planned edit to quality/knowledge/domain-foundations.v1.json.

specialistReviews.finding: Actual diff must fail if the promised registry change is not implemented.
specialistReviews.resolution: Actual architecture resolver receives no projected ownership and regression asserts unresolved actual state.

specialistReviews.finding: New files must participate in projected scope before creation.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add explicit plannedAdditions to execution-route projected matching and Plan Gate projectedFiles.

challenge.resolution: Use exact projected ownership only during planned projection.

challenge.resolution: Explicit plannedAdditions become projected execution-route files.

challenge.resolution: Do not infer ownership from expectedDomains; require exact path mapping.

challenge.scenario: Plan maps a file to UNKNOWN-DOMAIN.
challenge.resolution: Require domain to exist in current domainIndexDefinition.

challenge.scenario: Plan supplies wrong owner for a real domain.
challenge.finding: Could split domain and authority truth.
challenge.resolution: Owner must equal current canonical domain owner.

challenge.resolution: Projection authority requires domain-foundations inside plannedFilePatterns/semantic mustEdit.

challenge.finding: Projected intent must not produce completion PASS.

notes: Targeted follow-up discovered by #666 plan-only replay after #678. This transaction extends existing Semantic Execution / Plan Before Code only; no storefront product files and no parallel quality system.
